question: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the abolition of untouchability?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 17**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 17 **of the **Indian constitution **mainly deals with the account of untouchability. This article **puts restrictions **and **prohibits the practice of untouchability**.
